eras.name: Craft Age
eras.description: Food systems, record keeping, materials, hand tools and water management. Societies may borrow, rediscover or bypass particular techniques; this is not a compulsory cultural sequence.
eras.research: Established craft principles can be recombined rapidly. Local production may still depend on manual labour and scarce skilled craftspeople.

eras.name: Mechanical & Early Industrial Age
eras.description: Reliable mechanical power, precision workshops, organised supply and bulk production. Imported plant may coexist with local craft.
eras.research: Mechanisation, standardisation and precision tooling enable repeatable production. Improving an understood machine is distinct from building the factories that reproduce it.

eras.name: Electrical & Mechanised Age
eras.description: Conventional electrical, chemical and transport industries. This is Malaspina’s current native technological envelope, with unequal national capacity and access.
eras.research: Conventional gases, fuels, alloys, engines and airframes belong here where their underlying processes are established. Refinement is normally work within the age, not a plasma-scale scientific breakthrough.

eras.name: Advanced Planetary Age
eras.description: Possible developments beyond established local practice: advanced electronics, nuclear energy, sophisticated materials and medicine. These entries are not automatically available anywhere on Malaspina.
eras.research: Identify the particular new material, measurement method, electronic process or biological principle required. A familiar improvement is not promoted into this age merely because it performs unusually well.

eras.name: Spacefaring & High-Energy Age
eras.description: Orbital and interplanetary infrastructure, compact high-energy equipment and specialised fields. Individual applications need their own scale, reliability and manufacturing records.
eras.research: Compact plasma, shielding, gravitic systems and void infrastructure can require foundations absent from native industry. Borrowed devices can enable operation before independent manufacture; solve each missing foundation separately.

eras.name: Specialist 40K Branches
eras.description: Psychic engineering, warp systems, exotic xenos sciences and lost human systems. These branches are alternatives, not one universal final age or guaranteed unlock sequence.
eras.research: Psychic, warp, Necron and other specialist routes have their own dependencies. They are not a compulsory sixth age; psychic traditions can coexist with craft societies.

nodes.scope: Psychic interaction with materials and mechanisms; each demonstrated process records its practitioners and limitations.

nodes.name: Warp propulsion & protection
nodes.scope: Propulsion, protection and navigation must be established separately. Not required for all spacefaring civilisations; Hunters have no established warp capability.

nodes.name: Aeldari psychoplastic traditions
nodes.scope: A distinct lore reference, not an automatic human unlock or known local process.

nodes.name: Necron phase & dimensional systems
nodes.scope: Distinct exotic research branch; a generic engineering pathway is not established.

nodes.name: Biotransference
nodes.scope: Necron/C’tan precedent; not simply the next level of cybernetics or a guaranteed reversible procedure.

nodes.name: STC systems & retained design libraries
nodes.scope: Knowledge repositories and production systems are assets, not an age or an automatic prerequisite for invention.

nodes.name: Artificial machine intellect
nodes.scope: A separate branch with faction-specific implementations and restrictions; neither mandatory nor locally established.

research_routes.name: Refinement within an age
research_routes.rule: Improve a known process or design using established principles. For Galahad, a bounded familiar design problem may take hours or days; physical trials have their own duration. Do not impose the timetable for discovering alien plasma technology.
research_routes.example: Improve a conventional gas cell, alloy recipe, engine layout or workshop process.

research_routes.name: Integration of known technologies
research_routes.rule: Combine established components into a new system. Research concerns interfaces and performance, while prototype testing, scale and construction are estimated separately. Large size alone does not make every component a new scientific discovery.
research_routes.example: The carrier combines conventional aviation and structural branches; its unresolved lift and mass balance must be assessed separately from ordinary materials improvements.

research_routes.name: A new foundation or age transition
research_routes.rule: Name the missing principle or production process, the evidence available and the tools needed to test it. Estimate those gaps rather than assigning a fixed waiting period for the whole age. Galahad can cross branches without first industrialising an entire nation.
research_routes.example: Independent Hunter plasma manufacture requires resolving the unfamiliar power, containment, materials and control systems that remain after his existing emitter research.

research_routes.name: Transfer and derivative design
research_routes.rule: Carry established knowledge and production methods into every relevant application. Charge only for changed requirements; never repeat a completed breakthrough or its full development period.
research_routes.example: A shoulder caster inherits relevant plasma-rifle research; mounting, aiming and wearer interfaces are separate remaining work.
